title: HB472 (2025-2026 Regular Session): Crimes and offenses; add certain facilities of the Geo. L. Smith II Georgia World Congress Center Authority to the locations in which the carrying of weapons or long guns is prohibited

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official legis.ga.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text: SECTION 1 (amending O.C.G.A. 16-11-127(b)): "(8) Within facilities of the Geo. L. Smith II Georgia World Congress Center Authority, as described in Code Section 10-9-14.1, which are enclosed by fencing that is at least 8 feet in height and includes prominent postings of notice of such restrictions at all access points; provided, however, that such facility is not a location where vehicles are permitted to park."
